rationale: The vocabulary is accessible but varied, with long, rhythmic sentences and dry, whimsical humor (bureaucratic fantasy, a bleeding-yet-polite wall of 'ADEQUATE' frames); the scene intensity is limited to creeping supernatural unease with no graphic violence, profanity, or sexual content, while the countdown-to-demon plot and satire of workplace and institutional life give it enough thematic sophistication to appeal to teens and crossover adult readers.
